objects.name: device
objects.description: One piece of a community lab's kit: a terminal, an access point, the router, a server, a solar array or a battery bank. The kind says which.

indexes.name: room
indexes.description: The room browse, so a steward can list what sits in one room of the hub.

indexes.name: serial
indexes.description: Finds a device by the serial number on its label, and stops the same device being entered twice.

objects.name: wiring
objects.description: Which device is cabled or associated to which, which device is part of which, and which device keeps watch on which.

objects.name: reading
objects.description: One quantity the lab's devices report — whether a device is online, how much traffic it carries, how full a battery is — its unit and its limits.

objects.name: sample
objects.description: One reading from one device at one moment.

objects.name: retention_rule
objects.description: How long samples of one kind are kept.
